description: R08 Host ScreenBuffer alternate-buffer checkpoint: safe Rust owns alternate-buffer replacement/linkage, cursor inheritance/restoration, active-buffer VT dispatch and RIS return-to-main semantics.

entries.notes: Safe Rust creates a distinct alternate state linked to the persistent main owner and removes that transient linkage when returning to main.
Creating an alternate while already in alternate state replaces the transient alternate while retaining the same persistent main owner.
Repeated alternate creation from main replaces the previous transient alternate and inherits current main cursor state.
Alternate creation inherits full cursor state; return-to-main preserves main position while carrying visibility/style/blinking back from the alternate.
Cursor size and type are copied into newly created alternate state.
VT writes issued through the main screen owner dispatch to the active alternate, moving only its cursor, attributes and text.
RIS exits alternate-screen state and restores main ownership.
